request: Cockpit interactive objects: hovering the pointer must outline the object in red as on Wii (it flooded the view with a green glow, then showed rectangle edges, then nothing)
effect_sequence: 1) object drawn normally with depth write; 2) A8 copy of its screen rectangle saves the EFB alpha and clears it to 0; 3) the same geometry is redrawn with color off, alpha on, dst alpha 255, depth LEQUAL, no depth write (marks the silhouette in alpha); 4) second A8 copy = silhouette mask; 5) a screen quad samples the mask at offsets and draws the red outline; 6) the saved alpha is restored.

causes_and_fixes.cause: Aurora GXCopyTex pushed an alpha clear to the dst-alpha value before any copy made while dst alpha was enabled. Unscissored it filled the whole EFB alpha (bloom mask -> full-screen glow); scissored it filled the copy rectangle, so the mask was the rectangle (red rectangle edges). The hardware has no such clear: dst alpha only affects pixels being drawn.

Dst alpha was implemented only through the blend constant (alpha blend Constant/Zero, SetBlendConstant per draw). For the alpha-only marking draws the written alpha came out as 0 (mask copy measured 0-19/255 although the draws rasterized: forcing color on showed the exact silhouette). Making the TEV write alpha 1 instead restored the outline (user-confirmed on the centre panel and the other interactive cockpit objects). The reason the constant path wrote 0 was not identified.
causes_and_fixes.fix: ShaderConfig::dstAlpha: when the color blend does not read source alpha (color off, or blend factors without SRCALPHA/INVSRCALPHA), the fragment shader writes the dst-alpha value after the alpha compare and the alpha blend is One/Zero (gx/pipeline.hpp shader_dst_alpha, gx/shader.cpp, gx/gx.cpp to_blend_state). Draws whose color blend reads source alpha keep the blend-constant path.

also_changed: gx/shader.cpp: vertex position declared @invariant (equal-depth LEQUAL redraws across different shaders).

GXPipelineConfigVersion 19 -> 20; gfx/pipeline_cache.cpp migrates version-19 rows (bundled and user caches) by inserting dstAlpha = none and recomputing it, so caches stay warm (4588 rows migrated on the first run).
performance_note: The ~27 FPS seen during the investigation came from diagnostic runs with draw merging disabled (WII_COMPILED_DIAG_NO_MERGE); that switch no longer exists.

validation.user: red outline correct with the TEV-alpha experiment, which the final shader path reproduces generally
